response.justification: Bogdan has deep technical expertise, extensive open-source contributions, and leadership in diverse tech environments, but lacks demonstrated experience in IT architecture design, UML, and formal project management — critical for this role — and his German proficiency is only basic, falling short of the C1 requirement.
strengths: Strong open-source leadership with GISCollective and multiple public tools
Proven full-stack experience across languages, platforms, and high-scale systems
Active mentor and educator with workshops, talks, and team knowledge-sharing
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting C1 requirement
No clear evidence of UML, IT architecture design, or formal project management experience
Lacks documented experience in client advisory, compliance, or risk management contexts
